criteria.text: Inspect /app/solution.md. Does it define a good recipe explain answer as read-only metadata that covers scopes, named locations, managed/unmanaged settings, optional groups, lifecycle, redaction, and native operation summaries?
Rate whether the explanation gives users a clear support model without making settings groups or schema internals mandatory public concepts.
Rate whether the answer preserves the no-live-read, no-desired-payload, no-native-execution, no-secret-value boundary for recipe explain.
